name: Camille Aubert
notes: Executive sponsor for any force-majeure response. Sole authority to approve an emergency supplier derogation, an air-freight exception, or any allocation that cuts a key account below 70% of committed volume.

name: Henrik Sørensen
notes: Owns the supplier panel and the alternate-sourcing decision. Approves spot purchases up to EUR 500,000 without executive sign-off. Led the 2024 emergency purchase from SUP-EU-023 and holds the existing framework agreement.

name: Marta Ruiz
notes: Day-to-day owner of the SUP-EU-014 relationship and the pectin category. First point of contact for capacity confirmation from SUP-EU-023 and for reopening the SUP-LATAM-004 audit.

name: Thomas Berger
notes: Approves inter-plant stock transfers and any break of the 48-hour frozen production schedule beyond 24 hours. Owns the reallocation decision between PLANT-ES-01, PLANT-FR-03 and the three affected sites.

name: Aisha Haddad
notes: Builds the constrained-ingredient production plan and the contribution-margin-per-kilogram ranking that drives which SKUs are decampaigned. Maintains the depletion model that produced signal SIG-2026-0903-001.

name: Pierre Lemoine
notes: Runs the most exposed site at 12 days of cover and the group's only Kids pouch line. Can authorise a schedule freeze break of up to 24 hours on his own authority. Must be consulted on any changeover-heavy decampaigning plan.

name: Katrin Vogel
notes: Approves overtime and weekend shifts at Bremen and Ghent, including the EUR 22,000 Saturday shift that adds roughly 38,000 units at PLANT-DE-02.

name: Dr. Elena Novak
notes: Co-approver with the executive sponsor for any emergency supplier derogation. Owns the E440 labelling assessment, the organic-compatibility ruling on amidated LM pectin, and the sensory and shelf-life re-validation gate for any reformulation.

name: Julien Mercier
notes: Quantifies revenue at risk, margin erosion and penalty exposure, and co-approves air freight with the Sustainability Director. Owns the business case for accepting the 18% SUP-EU-023 price premium.

name: Sophie Delacroix
notes: Owns the customer allocation decision and the 48-hour notification rule. Signs off any customer cut below 60% of committed volume and coordinates the National Account Managers for CUST-001, CUST-004, CUST-007 and CUST-011. Also decides on promotional suspension and media spend redirection.
